title: The ordinary realization/restriction/direct-image cube
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings, φ:A→B a ring homomorphism, and g:Z→Y any scheme morphism. Write E_TA and E_TB for the intrinsic realization equivalences, V_T for fixed-scalar restriction and U_T for intrinsic restriction [lem-sf-compact-support-restriction-of-scalars]; write Q_B for fixed-scalar direct image and P_A,P_B for intrinsic direct images, with section-normalized comparisons d_A and d_B [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-direct-adjunction]. Let c_T:E_TB U_T≅V_T E_TA be sfRealizationRestriction and let h:P_B U_Y≅U_Z P_A be proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison [lem-weil-proetale-direct-image-restriction-of-scalars]. For every ordinary fixed-scalar B-sheaf M, P_A(c_Z(M)); d_A(V_Z M) equals h.inv(E_ZB M); U_Y(d_B(M)); c_Y(Q_B M). No boundedness, properness or flatness hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 00YV and 03D1; the section-normalized realization comparisons, Step 1 of lem-finite-realization-restriction-cube.

proof.text: Precompose with the invertible ordinary coefficient comparison h.hom, cancel h.hom followed by h.inv, and evaluate on an object W of the target site and a section x. The underlying linear realization unit at the base-changed object is invertible; its surjectivity writes x as the realization unit of a section m.

The ordinary direct-image coefficient comparison and the realization restriction comparisons are the identity on underlying sections by their chosen normalizations. The direct-image realization comparisons send the source realization unit to the target realization unit. Thus both composites at x equal the same underlying sheafification-unit section; the units before and after scalar restriction agree on their underlying abelian presheaves. Sectionwise extensionality proves the identity. The argument covers zero rings and empty schemes without an additional hypothesis.

theorem realizationRestriction_ordinary_directImage_cube
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Z ⟶ Y)
    (M : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Z) (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B))) :
    (proEtaleConstantModuleDirectImage g A).map
        ((sfRealizationRestriction Z φ).hom.app M) ≫
      (sfIntrinsicDirectImageComparison g A).hom.app ((sfFixedRestriction Z φ).obj M) =
    (proEtaleCoefficientDirectImageComparison g φ).inv.app
        ((sfIntrinsicModuleEquivalence Z B).functor.obj M) ≫
      (proEtaleCoefficientRestrictScalars Y φ).map
        ((sfIntrinsicDirectImageComparison g B).hom.app M) ≫
      (sfRealizationRestriction Y φ).hom.app
        ((ProEtale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1, u} B)) g).obj M)
